title: TRAJ : Transition in Rheumatology, From Adolescence to Adulthood
official: From Adolescence to Adulthood : Analysis of the Impact of the CAPADJA Transition Support Program in Rheumatology at Bordeaux University Hospital
summary: This study evaluates the impact of the CAPAdJA transition support program on care continuity for young patients with chronic rheumatic diseases at Bordeaux University Hospital. The primary objective is to compare the proportion of patients lost to follow-up six months after the transition consultation between those who benefited from CAPAdJA and those who did not.

interventions.name: Self-questionnaire : satisfaction and quality of life

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients who benefited from a pediatric-to-adult rheumatology transition consultation at Bordeaux University Hospital between 2017 and 2024
* Patients over 18 years old at the time of completing the self-administered questionnaire.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who do not speak French
* Patients who have refused to participating
